title: 20bb · Flop · Broader queen-high paired
description: A complete saved flop-to-river game on Qc 6d 6s at 20bb initial depth, with a 12bb pot and 14bb behind. Broader weighted ranges include quads, a full house, trips, overpairs, top pairs, offsuit broadways and unpaired suited connectors. Half-pot, pot, all-in and one subsequent raise are modeled across all three streets.
rangeAssumptions: Illustrative starting ranges and per-combination inclusion multipliers: BTN QQ x1, AQo x0.75, KK x1, A6s x0.75, JTs x0.5, 98s x0.5, KQs x1; BB 66 x1, QJs x1, 76s x0.75, TT x0.75, KQo x0.5, 87s x0.5, A5s x0.5. These multipliers describe starting-range inclusion, not action frequencies. Public blockers are removed before normalization and private pairs are sampled jointly with exact card removal. These priors are declared study assumptions, not certified preflop frequencies or outputs of a solved earlier betting line. All later actions and ordered card arrivals belong to one jointly solved conditional flop-to-river game. This does not certify full-hand Hold'em or replace the existing full-hand 20bb model. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
